description: python tools/lint_handoffs.py (global gate, must exit 0 before any handoff completes) reports 42 UNACKNOWLEDGED findings against 2915 handoffs: 10 BLOCKER + 31 MAJOR + 1 MINOR, on top of 291 already-acknowledged baseline entries. The 42 findings cluster entirely on handoffs produced by three out-of-band (non-registry-routed) runs from 2026-08-14/15 that are absent from tools/lint_handoffs.baseline.json. Break down: (A) 5 H003 BLOCKER — completed_at precedes started_at (non-whole-hour); (B) 5 H013 BLOCKER — completed_at is exactly 5.0h before started_at (whole-hour offset, the .ToUniversalTime() omission signature / local-time-labelled-Z); (C) 30 H007 MAJOR — missing required schema keys from_agent AND to_agent across 15 files (2 findings per file); (D) 1 H009 MAJOR — WF02-prm-batch2-20260814/step-02a-backend-dev.json left IN_PROGRESS while 7 later steps COMPLETED; (E) 1 H010 MINOR — 71 of 2915 handoffs (2.4%) absent from handoffs/registry.json, including ADHOC-prm-env-20260814/step-00-backend-dev.json (0 registry matches). All finding timestamps are 2026-08-14/15, i.e. NEW debt that arose after prior lint-debt issues GH-594, GH-596, GH-666, GH-751 were closed.

root_cause: Same root-cause class as ISS-0626/ISS-0627: bookkeeping directives were followed for work product but not for the record of the work. The three out-of-band runs executed on 2026-08-14/15 wrote handoff files using timestamps from session context / local-time-labelled-Z (H003/H013), omitted from_agent/to_agent schema keys (H007), left a step orphaned IN_PROGRESS while routing past it (H009), and one run's files were never registered in handoffs/registry.json (H010). Because these runs happened after the 2026-08-10 baseline regeneration, their findings are NOT covered by the acknowledgment mechanism and re-surface as new unacknowledged debt. Severity of the issue itself is MAJOR: it is bookkeeping/audit-trail debt that reds the lint gate, not a runtime defect.
investigation_notes: Verified live on 2026-08-16T00:12..00:17Z: (1) full lint run captured (291 ACKNOWLEDGED from baseline + 42 unacknowledged); (2) H003 exact inversions recorded per file (e.g. ADHOC-prm-env-20260814/step-00-backend-dev.json completed_at 2026-08-14T14:39:42Z < started_at 2026-08-14T19:37:32Z); (3) H013 offset is uniformly 5.0h across all 5 files (consistent single-session local-time drift); (4) H007 = missing from_agent+to_agent pair, 2 findings per each of 15 files; (5) H009 = WF02-prm-batch2-20260814/step-02a-backend-dev.json status IN_PROGRESS with 7 later COMPLETED steps in the same run; (6) H010 = registry.json absent-from-registry count 71/2915 (2.4%), ADHOC-prm-env-20260814 has 0 registry matches for its 1 handoff file. Prior-art disposition per class (from ISS-0627/GH-596 resolution): H013 correction was REJECTED there and folded into the acknowledgment mechanism; H003/H009 are permanent-record categories (no field recovers the true value); H007 was corrected in prior runs by renaming workflow_id/sequence -> run_id/step where the file is a real handoff; H010 was repaired in WF03-GH594-20260808 by registry backfill. Step 3 must decide per-class whether to correct or acknowledge, following that prior art.
